limitations: Task-local proposal only; it does not change the production generator, canonical rule, catalog, or approval state.
The default expansion_mode='bbox' program is byte-for-byte the canonical Racket program.
Only expansion_mode in {'bbox','corridor'} is supported; marker color, frame/interior roles, and input grammar remain fixed.
The mode is chosen once per episode from a rule-only deterministic stream; inputs come from a separate stream.
Evidence retains two episodes (one per mode), four query rotations per episode, and the single declared rival mode.
Finite examples refute the declared rival but do not prove identification against arbitrary programs or establish training suitability.
The labeled execution canary validates runtime plumbing and is not part of either public episode.

parameter_contract.input_stream: separate deterministic stream independent of expansion_mode
parameter_contract.name: expansion_mode
parameter_contract.sampling_unit: once per episode from a rule-only deterministic seed stream

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cyan (first (find-color g 8)))
                  (cr (first cyan))
                  (cc (second cyan))
                  (non-bg (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                     (flatmap (lambda (c)
                                                (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                  (if (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8))
                                                      (list (list r c v))
                                                      (list))))
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                   (range 0 h)))
                  (rs (map first non-bg))
                  (cs (map second non-bg))
                  (r1 (min-list rs))
                  (r2 (max-list rs))
                  (c1 (min-list cs))
                  (c2 (max-list cs))
                  (frame-col (at g r1 c1))
                  (inner-col (let loop
                                  ((cells non-bg))
                                  (if (null? cells)
                                      frame-col
                                      (if (!= (third (first cells)) frame-col)
                                          (third (first cells))
                                          (loop (rest cells))))))
                  (new-r1 (if (< cr r1) cr r1))
                  (new-r2 (if (> cr r2) cr r2))
                  (new-c1 (if (< cc c1) cc c1))
                  (new-c2 (if (> cc c2) cc c2)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and (>= r new-r1) (<= r new-r2) (>= c new-c1) (<= c new-c2)) (if (or (= r new-r1) (= r new-r2) (= c new-c1) (= c new-c2))
                              frame-col
                              inner-col))
                        (else 0)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cyan (first (find-color g 8)))
                  (cr (first cyan))
                  (cc (second cyan))
                  (non-bg (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                     (flatmap (lambda (c)
                                                (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                  (if (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8))
                                                      (list (list r c v))
                                                      (list))))
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                   (range 0 h)))
                  (rs (map first non-bg))
                  (cs (map second non-bg))
                  (r1 (min-list rs))
                  (r2 (max-list rs))
                  (c1 (min-list cs))
                  (c2 (max-list cs))
                  (frame-col (at g r1 c1)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2)) v)
                        ((and (= r cr)
                              (or (and (< cc c1) (>= c cc) (< c c1))
                                  (and (> cc c2) (> c c2) (<= c cc))))
                         frame-col)
                        ((and (= c cc)
                              (or (and (< cr r1) (>= r cr) (< r r1))
                                  (and (> cr r2) (> r r2) (<= r cr))))
                         frame-col)
                        (else 0)))))))
